text.zhHant: 專業摘要
六年精密製造品保經驗，專長於根因分析與統計製程管制。曾主導導入即時製程回饋機制，使不良率下降 40%；並帶領團隊一次通過 ISO 9001 換版稽核。熟悉 MSA、SPC、8D 與車廠稽核實務。
text.en: Six years in precision manufacturing quality assurance, specialising in root-cause analysis and statistical process control. Led the introduction of real-time process feedback that cut the defect rate by 40%, and guided the team through an ISO 9001 transition audit, passed first time. Experienced with MSA, SPC, 8D and automotive customer audits.

text.zhHant: 工作經歷

明衡科技有限公司｜品保工程師｜2020 年 3 月 – 迄今
・主導壓入工序根因分析，將客訴件數由年 15 件降至 9 件（-40%）。做法是追查前三大客訴型態至產線源頭，其中兩項改以治具防呆後不再發生。
・建置即時製程參數監測，涵蓋 34 個感測點，全廠不良率由 1.87% 降至 1.12%。
・擔任 ISO 9001:2015 換版專案窗口，一次通過外部稽核，無重大不符合事項。
・訓練新進檢驗員 5 名，編寫檢驗標準作業程序 12 份。

宏昌工業股份有限公司｜品管員｜2018 年 7 月 – 2020 年 2 月
・負責進料檢驗與供應商評鑑，管理 28 家供應商。
・導入抽樣計畫（MIL-STD-105E），將進料檢驗工時減少 30%。
text.en:
Minghen Technology Ltd. | QA Engineer | Mar 2020 – Present
・Led root-cause analysis of the press-fit process, reducing annual customer complaints from 15 to 9 (-40%) by tracing the top three complaint types back to the line; two were eliminated entirely with mistake-proofing fixtures.
・Built real-time process monitoring across 34 sensing points; plant defect rate fell from 1.87% to 1.12%.
・Served as project lead for the ISO 9001:2015 transition; passed the external audit first time with no major non-conformities.
・Trained five new inspectors and authored 12 inspection SOPs.

Hongchang Industrial Co., Ltd. | Quality Inspector | Jul 2018 – Feb 2020
・Responsible for incoming inspection and supplier evaluation across 28 suppliers.
・Introduced MIL-STD-105E sampling, cutting incoming inspection hours by 30%.

description.th: ภูมิหลัง การศึกษา ประสบการณ์ และเป้าหมาย

text.zhHant: 自傳
一、關於我

我是張建豪，桃園人，家中三代經營小型機械加工廠。從小在車床與銑床的聲音裡長大，也很早就看見父親為了一批退貨徹夜重工的樣子。那件事讓我對「品質」兩個字的理解，不是課本上的定義，而是一整個晚上的燈光。

這也是我後來選擇機械工程、又走進品保領域的原因。
text.en:
My name is Chien-Hao Chang. I grew up in Taoyuan, in a family that has run a small machining workshop for three generations. I grew up with the sound of lathes and milling machines, and I was young when I first saw my father work through the night to rework a rejected batch. That night taught me what "quality" means in a way no textbook definition could.

It is also why I later chose mechanical engineering, and then quality assurance.

text.zhHant: 二、求學歷程

大學就讀國立○○科技大學機械工程系。大二那年參加全國機械設計競賽，我們這組在初賽被淘汰 —— 原因不是設計不好，而是公差標註錯誤，零件根本組不起來。那次失敗讓我開始認真對待「精度」這件事，也是我後來選擇量測與品管作為研究方向的起點。

碩士班師從李明哲教授，論文題目是製程參數回饋對不良率的影響。研究期間我在合作廠商的產線駐點三個月，那三個月學到的東西比實驗室兩年還多 —— 尤其是「資料乾淨與否，決定分析有沒有意義」這件事。
text.en:
I studied mechanical engineering at National ○○ University of Science and Technology. In my second year my team was eliminated in the first round of the national machine design competition — not because the design was poor, but because we had mislabelled a tolerance and the parts simply would not fit. That failure was where I began to take precision seriously, and it led me towards metrology and quality control.

For my master's I studied under Professor Ming-Che Lee, writing on the effect of process parameter feedback on defect rates. I spent three months stationed on a partner company's production line during that research, and learned more in those three months than in two years in the laboratory — above all that whether the data is clean decides whether the analysis means anything.

text.zhHant: 三、工作經歷與收穫

畢業後先進入宏昌工業擔任品管員，負責進料檢驗。那是一份重複性很高的工作，但我在其中找到可以改的地方：原本每一批都全檢，我導入抽樣計畫後，檢驗工時減少三成，而漏檢率沒有上升。

2020 年轉職到明衡科技，開始接觸根因分析。最有成就感的一次，是把客訴從一年 15 件降到 9 件。做法其實不複雜 —— 不是把檢驗變嚴，而是把前三大客訴型態一路追回產線，找出真正的源頭。其中兩項改成治具防呆之後，就再也沒有發生過。

這件事讓我確認了一個判斷：品保的價值不在攔截不良品，而在讓不良品不要產生。
text.en:
After graduating I joined Hongchang Industrial as a quality inspector, handling incoming inspection. It was repetitive work, but I found something worth changing: every batch had been inspected in full, and after I introduced a sampling plan, inspection hours fell by thirty per cent with no rise in escapes.

In 2020 I moved to Minghen Technology and began working on root-cause analysis. The result I am proudest of is reducing customer complaints from fifteen a year to nine. The method was not complicated — not stricter inspection, but tracing the top three complaint types back to their origin on the line. Two of them stopped entirely once mistake-proofing fixtures were fitted.

That confirmed a view I still hold: the value of quality assurance is not in catching defects but in preventing them.

text.zhHant: 四、我的不足與正在做的事
我最需要補強的是跨部門溝通。我對技術細節掌握得還可以，但在會議上常常直接講結論，忘了其他部門沒有跟著我一起推導。去年主管給我的回饋就是這一點，今年我開始主動主持跨部門檢討會，練習把技術語言換成決策語言。目前還在進步中，但已經有同事說「這次聽懂了」。
text.en: The area I most need to strengthen is cross-functional communication. My grasp of technical detail is reasonable, but in meetings I tend to state conclusions directly, forgetting that other departments have not followed the reasoning with me. That was exactly the feedback my manager gave me last year. This year I began chairing cross-department reviews myself, practising how to turn technical language into decision language. I am still improving, but colleagues have started telling me they followed it this time.

text.zhHant: 五、生涯規劃

短期內我希望在現有基礎上，把即時回饋機制推廣到更多工序，並完成統計製程管制的進階認證。中期目標是成為能同時處理技術與跨部門協調的品保主管。

更長遠一點，我希望回到家裡的工廠，把這些年學到的東西帶回去 —— 那間工廠現在還是用父親三十年前的做法。這不是懷舊，是我知道台灣有幾千家這樣的工廠，而它們缺的不是設備，是方法。
text.en:
In the short term I want to extend the real-time feedback mechanism to more operations and complete an advanced certification in statistical process control. In the medium term I hope to become a quality manager able to handle both the technical work and the cross-department coordination.

Further out, I would like to return to my family's workshop and bring back what I have learned. It still runs the way my father ran it thirty years ago. This is not nostalgia: I know there are thousands of workshops like it in Taiwan, and what they lack is not equipment but method.

text.zhHant: 自傳
一、關於我
（從一個具體的場景或事件切入，不要從「我是一個○○的人」開始 —— 那種開頭讀者看過太多次了。）
text.en: （Open with a specific scene or event rather than "I am a ... person" — readers have seen that opening too many times.）

text.zhHant: 二、求學歷程
（挑一兩件真正影響你方向的事來寫，包括失敗的。流水帳式的學歷回顧沒有人想看 —— 履歷上已經有了。）
text.en: （Choose one or two things that genuinely shaped your direction, including failures. A chronological list adds nothing — it is already on your CV.）

text.zhHant: 三、工作經歷與收穫
（做了什麼 → 結果如何 → 你從中確認了什麼判斷。第三段是關鍵，那才是別人看不出來的部分。）
text.en: （What you did → what resulted → what conviction it left you with. The third part matters most; it is the part nobody can infer from your CV.）

text.zhHant: 四、我的不足與正在做的事
（誠實寫一項真正的弱點，以及你正在怎麼處理。寫「我太追求完美」會被當成沒有自覺。）
text.en: （Name one real weakness and what you are doing about it. "I am too much of a perfectionist" reads as a lack of self-awareness.）

text.zhHant: 五、生涯規劃
（短期、中期、長期。最好能與應徵的這個職位接得上，但不必假裝這家公司是你唯一的夢想。）
text.en: （Short, medium and long term. Ideally these connect to the role you are applying for — but you need not pretend this company is your only dream.）

Ms. Lin, Human Resources

text.zhHant: 敬啟者：

我在貴公司官網看到「品保工程師（車用零組件）」職缺，謹此應徵。職缺說明中提到「需具備車廠稽核實務經驗並能主導改善專案」，這正好是我過去三年的主要工作內容。

在明衡科技，我主導了一項製程回饋機制的導入，使全廠不良率由 1.87% 降至 1.12%。這個成果的關鍵不在加嚴檢驗，而在把偏移偵測的時間從「數百件之後」縮短到「當件」。我也擔任 ISO 9001 換版專案窗口，一次通過外部稽核，無重大不符合事項。

我注意到貴公司去年通過 IATF 16949 認證，正在擴充車用產品線。這與我的經驗接得上，也是我特別想加入的原因 —— 車用件的品質要求比我目前處理的更嚴格，我想在那樣的標準下工作。

隨函附上履歷一份。如蒙面談機會，我很樂意進一步說明上述專案的具體做法。感謝您撥冗閱讀。
text.en:
I am writing to apply for the Quality Assurance Engineer (Automotive Components) position advertised on your website. The listing asks for hands-on experience with automotive customer audits and the ability to lead improvement projects; that has been the substance of my work for the past three years.

At Minghen Technology I led the introduction of a process feedback mechanism that reduced the plant-wide defect rate from 1.87% to 1.12%. What made it work was not stricter inspection but shortening drift detection from several hundred parts to the current part. I also acted as project lead for our ISO 9001 transition, which passed external audit first time with no major non-conformities.

I noticed that your company achieved IATF 16949 certification last year and is expanding its automotive line. That is where my experience fits, and it is the reason I am particularly interested: automotive quality requirements are more demanding than those I handle today, and I would like to work to that standard.

My CV is enclosed. I would welcome the chance to explain the approach behind those projects in more detail. Thank you for your time.

・Within Osaka: subway day pass ¥800, worth it from three rides.

text.zhHant: 謝卡

親愛的淑惠阿姨：

謝謝您特地從台中北上參加我們的婚禮。那天實在太忙亂，只來得及跟您說幾句話，心裡一直過意不去。

您送的那套餐具我們已經用上了，庭安說每次吃飯都想到您。更要謝謝您在婚禮前一週幫忙聯絡花店 —— 原本那家臨時說做不出來，是您託朋友找到替代的，我們才沒有開天窗。那件事我們會記很久。

下次回台中一定去看您。

祝　平安喜樂
text.en:
Dear Aunt Shu-Hui,

Thank you for making the trip up from Taichung for our wedding. The day was so hectic that we only managed a few words with you, and it has been on my mind ever since.

We are already using the dinner set you gave us — Ting-An says he thinks of you at every meal. I want to thank you especially for contacting the florist the week before. When the original shop pulled out at short notice, it was you who found a replacement through a friend, and that is the only reason we were not left with empty tables. We will remember it for a long time.

We will come and see you next time we are in Taichung.

With love,

text.zhHant:
思妤、庭安　敬上
116 年 3 月 20 日
謝卡

親愛的（稱謂）：

（開頭：謝謝對方做的那件事，寫清楚是哪一件）

（主體：那件事對你造成什麼具體的差別。「謝謝你的幫忙」誰都會寫，寫出「如果沒有你，會發生什麼」才有份量。）

（如果收到禮物：說出你怎麼用它，比說「很喜歡」真誠）

（結尾：後續的聯繫或祝福）
text.en:
Dear （name）,

（Opening: thank them for the specific thing they did.）

（Body: what concrete difference it made. Anyone can write "thank you for your help"; what carries weight is saying what would have happened without them.）

（If it was a gift: saying how you are using it is more sincere than saying you like it.）

（Closing: staying in touch, or a good wish.）
